column1: # comment: Email alignments. EmailMessage is equivalent to schema:EmailMessage; the rest use skos:closeMatch (cross-type/loose) to schema.org, the Nepomuk Message Ontology (NMO), and SIOC. The reified MessageParticipant relator (issue #159) is canonical; flat from/to/cc/bcc and their schema.org/NMO counterparts are lossy projection shortcuts. Trust terms (RelayHop/AuthenticationResult/signatures) are canonical — no maintained external RDF vocabulary exists for them. MessageParticipantRole envelope/resent roles are also canonical — no external vocabulary covers them. threadSubject and subjectPrefix (issue #138) are canonical — no maintained external vocabulary exposes thread-level normalized subject or per-message prefix stripping. MessageKind and its individuals (issue #137) are canonical — no maintained external vocabulary covers DSN/ARF/MDN/auto-generated report kinds. priority, importance, precedence, autoSubmitted, readReceiptRequested, and dispositionNotificationTo (issue #137) are canonical — no maintained external vocabulary covers these behavioral header facets.
